title: Finite half-linear-memory RPCD certificate on positive equicorrelations
statement: For every positive equicorrelation B=(1-rho)I+rho 11^T, 0<rho<1, let q=ceil(n/2) and use the q-step local triangular-inverse dual feature. Its regression certificate proves K(B)>=(25mu/98)B^{-1}>(mu/4)B^{-1}, where mu=1-rho. Hence this feature yields O(n/mu log(1/epsilon)) coordinate complexity on the family; diagonal sign conjugates are included.
assumptions: Positive equicorrelation or a diagonal sign conjugate
open_objections: The conditional-tail norm and preconditioner bounds are proved only for the equicorrelation structure, not a general SPD matrix.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
